claims.content: Allow the customer to view and edit their personal account information across multiple pages.

goal.raw_text: Allow the customer to view and edit their personal account information across multiple pages.

claims.content: Customer
The customer is on the Customer-Facing Website.
The customer has successfully signed in to their account via the Sign-in Page.
The customer has navigated to the My Account Page from the Home Page or Catalog Pages.
The customer navigates to the My Account Page and selects an option to edit their account information.

trigger.raw_text: The customer navigates to the My Account Page and selects an option to edit their account information.

claims.content: The customer selects an option to edit their account information from the My Account Page.
The system displays one of the My Account Edit Pages (Page 1, 2, 3, or 4) for the customer to modify their details.
The customer enters or updates their personal information on the selected edit page.
The customer submits the updated information.
The system validates the submitted information and saves the changes to the customer's account.
The system confirms the successful update and returns the customer to the My Account Page or a confirmation screen.

If the customer selects 'My Current Bids', 'My Bid History', 'My Watch List', or 'Recently Ended Auctions' from the My Account Page, the system displays the corresponding page for viewing bid and auction activity.
If the customer selects 'Registration Page 1' or 'Registration Page 2' from the My Account Page, the system displays the respective registration page for completing or updating registration details.
If the system detects invalid or incomplete data during submission on a My Account Edit Page, it displays an error message and retains the user on the current edit page to correct the input.
If the customer’s session expires while editing account information, the system redirects them to the Sign-in Page to re-authenticate before resuming edits.
If the customer attempts to access a My Account Edit Page without being signed in, the system redirects them to the Sign-in Page.
The customer’s account information has been successfully updated and saved in the system.
The customer is returned to the My Account Page or a confirmation screen after successful update.
All four My Account Edit Pages (Page 1, 2, 3, 4) are available for editing different sections of the customer’s profile.
